description_en: Deletes the Internet bandwidth of an IPv6 address by calling the DeleteIpv6InternetBandwidth operation
description_zh: 调用DeleteIpv6InternetBandwidth接口删除公网带宽
kebab_example: aliyun vpc delete-ipv6-internet-bandwidth --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --ipv6-address-id ipv6-2zen5j4axcp5l5qyy0000 --ipv6-internet-bandwidth-id ipv6bw-uf6hcyzu65v98v3du0000 --dry-run true --client-token 123e4567-e89b-12d3-a456-426655440000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DeleteIpv6InternetBandwidth

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the IPv6 gateway.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html operation to query the region ID
parameters.help_zh:
IPv6网关的地域ID。

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html接口获取地域ID。
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the IPv6 address.

You must specify either Ipv6AddressId or Ipv6InternetBandwidthId
parameters.help_zh:
IPv6地址的ID。

您必须输入参数Ipv6AddressId和参数Ipv6InternetBandwidthId中的任意一个
parameters.name: ipv6_address_id

parameters.help_en: The Internet bandwidth instance ID of the IPv6 address
parameters.name: ipv6_internet_bandwidth_id

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to perform a dry run. Valid values:

true: performs a dry run without actually deleting the Internet bandwidth. The system checks the required parameters, request syntax, and business restrictions. If the check fails, the corresponding error message is returned. If the check succeeds, `DryRunOperation` is returned.

false (default): performs a dry run and sends the request. If the check succeeds, the Internet bandwidth is deleted
parameters.help_zh:
是否只预检此次请求，取值：

true：只预检此次请求，不会删除IPsec服务端。检查项包括是否填写了必需参数、请求格式、业务限制等。如果检查不通过，则返回对应错误信息。如果检查通过，则返回`DryRunOperation`。

false（默认值）：发送正常请求，通过检查后直接删除IPsec服务端
parameters.name: dry_run

parameters.help_en:
The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. You can use the client to generate the token, but you must make sure that the token is unique among different requests. The ClientToken value can contain only ASCII characters.
If you do not specify this parameter, the system uses the RequestId of the API request as the ClientToken. The RequestId may be different for each API request.
-
parameters.help_zh:
客户端Token，用于保证请求的幂等性。从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符。
若您未指定，则系统自动使用API请求的RequestId作为ClientToken标识。每次API请求的RequestId可能不一样。
-
parameters.name: client_token
